answer: Admission auction at a canyon pass blocks bulk fakes: 40 pass each epoch. Each applicant locks one sealed bid in a nebula till reveal. Winners pay their bid, burned; losers get it back minus 10 credits, and a losing bid cannot wander forward. One bid per key. At 45 credits clearing, 1,000 fakes burn 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 plus 10,000 fees, 55,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 55 once. Rented bids fail: slots stay with keys.
